Behind the scenes

Automation gallery

A few of the n8n workflows running quietly in the background — built to take repetitive intake and lead-gen work off my plate.

Document ops
Document Breakdown & Summarizer

Pulls new files from an inbox folder, runs OCR and AI classification on each one, then auto-renames and sorts them into the right folder. Everything gets logged to a spreadsheet, and if a deadline is detected, it books a calendar event automatically.

n8n Gemini OCR Google Drive Sheets Calendar
Lead generation
Google Maps Lead Scraper

Scrapes Google Maps for businesses matching a search, filters and dedupes the URLs, then crawls each site to pull contact emails. Clean, deduped lead lists land straight in a spreadsheet, ready to work.

n8n Web scraping Email extraction Sheets
Lead generation
Zip-Code Lead Generator

Loops through zip codes and subcategories pulled from a spreadsheet, queries a places API for matching businesses in each area, dedupes against existing records, then appends the fresh leads to Google Sheets.

n8n Places API Sheets
Background

I started in customer-facing roles — Capital One, then American Express — handling high-volume queues where accuracy wasn't optional and every interaction was measured against a strict quality bar.

From there I moved into content and community operations, managing multi-channel workflows and reviewing user-generated content against platform standards at scale. That work sits at the intersection of judgment and process: someone has to decide, consistently, what's acceptable and what isn't.

That's the same muscle AI ops and data annotation ask for — labeling, reviewing, and refining the raw material that models learn from, with the same discipline I brought to compliance and quality review. I'm currently building toward that transition, one certificate and one shipped project at a time.
